anchor.policy: Old263 integer MSE <= epoch-zero MSE; no anchor gradients

change: Learn teacher root-child score gaps through verified frozen minimax support leaf differences; unchanged point/old-gap/preservation MSE and integer descent guards
comparison: Only after separately frozen unseen-family move-choice gate passes: basic classical Regicide,16 games,100ms

data.pair_target_policy: Old pairs are direct child values. Search-backed pair target gaps are teacher root-child differences, NOT literal teacher leaf labels. Frozen minimax support leaves reproduce the student branch values.
data.partition_policy: Source families and mirrored piece features disjoint across point/pair partitions
data.test_limit: Old69already exposed; newly reserved gate separate from all gradients and checkpoint selection
data.test_policy: Score once after final checkpoint saving; never optimize, stop, rank, or retry

gate_policy.exposure_policy: Every recorded neural FEN, teacher query, native/development probe and legal PV continuation; all previous gate roots and all legal children; color/rank-mirror canonical feature identity
gate_policy.limitations: Project-authored M2 source families were previously observed; only these extended root positions and all legal children are absent from the recorded learning/selection/teacher/probe inventory. This is a move-choice screen, not independent Elo evidence.
gate_policy.native_build_binding: Sealed before current learning collection or fitting
gate_policy.selection: Fixed even source indices0..30; UCI-lexicographic first legal noncapture/noncheck moves for exactly4plies; only recorded feature overlap allows extending same path to6 then8plies; no other refill, no teacher/model outputs

loss_definition: point teacher MSE + 1.0 * mean(old sibling gaps and teacher root-child gaps through verified support leaves) + 4.0 * old-TRAIN frozen-warm-prediction MSE; all normalized by10000 for gradients

preservation.gradients: Old TRAIN1426 only; complete normalized preservation mean per point minibatch
preservation.target: Frozen initial quantized white-cp output, not replacement teacher labels

selection: One seed/run; minimum tuning point MSE + pair-gap MSE subject to anchor guard; epoch0 protection and best restoration
